# Custom GCC and Cross Compilers

Homebrew depends on having an up-to-date version of Xcode because it comes with specific versions of build tools, e.g. `clang`. Installing a custom version of GCC or Autotools into your `PATH` has the potential to break lots of compiles so we prefer the Apple- or Homebrew-provided compilers. Cross compilers based on GCC will typically be "keg-only" and therefore not linked into your `PATH` by default, or be prefixed with t
